items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The names are clear (`compile_json_path_final_key`, `HasKeyOrArrayIndex`, `final_key`), the hook has an explanatory comment, and the formatting matches the surrounding code. The code is essentially the same as the reference.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Adds an overridable hook and reuses `compile_json_path` for the leading segments. A small subclass handles the array-index callers. There is no duplicated per-backend logic, and the temporary test file was deleted.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Small path-building change with no exception handling needed. It relies on the existing `json.dumps` quoting, adds no magic constants, and does not swallow any errors.

items.name: Array-index semantics kept for isnull / exact=None paths
items.name_zh: isnull / exact=None 路径保留数组下标语义
items.evidence: The final key is always compiled as `".%s" % json.dumps(key)` in shared `as_sql`, which covers SQLite, MySQL and Oracle. `KeyTransformIsNull.as_sqlite`/`as_oracle` and `KeyTransformExact.as_oracle` use `HasKeyOrArrayIndex`. Intermediate segments still go through `compile_json_path`.
